research_question: Does a material toroidal surface evolved synchronously with autonomous 3D Euler form an actual vortex tube, and does its full velocity field exhibit a certified relative periodic orbit with an independently calculated Euler tangent/Floquet frequency?
objective: Execute genuine Lagrangian material-surface RK4 tracking, require local vorticity tangency and volume transport, search all three velocity components for relative returns over the 24 proper cube rotations and periodic translations, validate the analytic Euler tangent linearization, and condition matrix-free monodromy on validated RPO. Physical PKLSA clock remains UNRESOLVED without convergence and distinct providers.
null_hypothesis: H0: current source-initialized Euler dynamics provides no qualified, reproducible material-vortex intrinsic clock; apparent Hilbert phase may be transient deformation, core/mesh artefact or spectral leakage.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: after independent material tube, relative periodic orbit and source qualification, the Euler/PKLSA vortex has a coherent recurrent phase stable under mesh, timestep and finite-core changes with a withheld Floquet frequency prediction.
assumptions: A064 original KnotPlot 3_1 source contains uncalibrated coordinates and an unverified physical relaxation; topology label has not independently passed source audit.
A064 unforced 3D incompressible Euler spectral projection with two-thirds Fourier truncation, RK4, periodic L=2pi computational box and dimensionless circulation gamma=1.
Geometry is remapped by A064 normalized_components; core regularization is a controllable numerical parameter and is NOT canonically equal to r_c.
Evolved full 3D velocity is a simulation, not a PKLSA native dynamical provider independent of KnotPlot/A064.
Measured q_shape and L^2 Z/E are different functionals of the same Euler realization; they are NOT independent experimental sources.
All historical A064 and A068 preflights are unblinded development evidence. A v1.0.8 BLIND ZIP does not restore epistemic blindness to already inspected sources.
No Lorentz time law, SST particle mass, SI speed, imposed oscillator frequency or frozen-time A064 eigenfrequency enters Euler right-hand side or phase fit.
A time-advected toroidal mesh is a material surface by construction, but a vortex tube additionally requires pointwise omega tangent to the surface; net flux zero is not proof.
Full-state symmetry quotient consists of 3D periodic translations and 24 proper signed permutation cubic rotations; arbitrary SO(3) rotations are not exact symmetries of the cubic periodic lattice.
RPO candidate search minimizes full-field relative L2 mismatch, but it does not solve a Newton-Krylov periodic shooting boundary-value problem or certify neutral symmetry multipliers.
The exact A064 tangent linearization is independent of measured q-shape and q-enstrophy phase; matrix-free monodromy/Ritz may run ONLY on a prequalified model RPO candidate.
A fixed random low-dimensional Ritz subspace is diagnostic; approximate eigenvalues require independent full-space residual and basis refinement before prediction.
Material geometry and vortex-tube evaluations share one KnotPlot/A064 seed and do not count as independent providers. No SI closure.

steps.operation: Hash 6 source files and exact A064 solver copy, reject mutations
Unblind method controls positive oscillator, rigid rotation and beating; preserve as method-only
Normalize unchanged native XYZ into periodic 2pi cube; deposit signed circulation; apply Gaussian finite-core and transverse Leray projection
Run genuine unforced spectral 3D Euler/RK4 trajectory to T=20, n16 dt.04 with 251 snapshots; compute energy/helicity/CFL/divergence
Compute independent functionals qshape and qZ from evolved 3D fields then Hilbert phase, no oscillator injected
Rerun n24, n16 dt=.02 and two finite-core branches (.32,.48) to fixed T, report differences even when science gate G5 is blocked
Do not mark G3 terminal without qualified material tube and relative periodic orbit; do not turn unresolved into fail
Register future independent Euler/Floquet frequency on a withheld provider before running G4-G8
Create a closed toroidal polygon mesh from original native trefoil, pre-register radius, sections and sides; keep separate from vortex qualification.
Evolve material mesh nodes with RK4 positions synchronized to same Euler intermediate stages and evaluate volume and omega-normal diagnostics at all snapshots.
Search full 3-component Euler velocity-field return under translations and proper cubic rotations; report minimum residual without scalar phase fit.
Independently compare analytic Euler tangent derivative to centered finite difference and validate manufactured two-mode Floquet operator oracle.
Only on RPO plus tube screening PASS calculate a finite low-rank relative monodromy Ritz screen with full-state residuals; never claim convergence/physics without shooting and grid/provider gates.

falsification_criteria.criterion: If E drift >=1e-5 or helicity drift >=1e-4 or divergence >=1e-9 or CFL >=.25 or dynamics unchanged, G2 FAIL numerical, not physical
If full-field 3D material tube and RPO are not independently qualified, G3 UNRESOLVED regardless of Hilbert phase

Physical clock positive only after >=6 clean cycles from two distinct functionals, RMS <.20rad, CV <.12, cross-frequency difference <.03, withheld operator frequency and three-axis convergence checks; none sufficient alone
Spatial relative final-Z >=.025 or finite-core response >=.05 is model-screen nonconvergence, not blanket SST falsification
Material-volume relative drift <0.05 and area-weighted vorticity tangency mean <0.05 with maximum <0.10 at all retained snapshots; otherwise material-tube qualification blocked.
Full 3D relative L2 return residual <0.025 plus repeated-shooting and independent refinement; a single candidate below threshold never counts as certified RPO.
True matrix-free Euler tangent monodromy eigenpair, basis-refinement and full-state residual <0.05, with frozen withheld phase frequency agreement; absent RPO means NOT_EXECUTED.

edge_cases: Monotonic/transient q can create spurious Hilbert phase
A rotating 3D vortex need not alter rotationally invariant shape tensor
Periodic cube disallows arbitrary rigid rotations as physical symmetries
Even excellent E,H conservation does not imply spatial convergence or material confinement
The geometry is an initial condition, not source-native time-resolved PKLSA dynamics
Do not interpret material tube advected by interpolation as an exact vortex tube.
One short transient relative return does not close an RPO boundary-value problem.
Ritz 5-vector subspace without convergence cannot be promoted to a Floquet frequency.
No independent native provider, SI time calibration, or physical SST/relativity claim.
predictions: Actual evolved velocity differs from t0 without enforced phase input
